title: [storage][sustainability] the set's demoted figures as ruled: leaked test schemas a diagnostic until it has read 0 for 7 days (hourly samples across the week, a missing one never a zero), then an alert figure only; dollars per landing a plain reading of the sustainability line with no range; free disk a diagnostic with no range (its alert is disk_low's), still sampled
prompt:
Spawn, objective 182 [storage][sustainability] (the owner's core metric set of 2026-11-14 18:42, its "Demoted" list, with the lead's rulings of 2026-11-16; the follow-up 176.json names; author rev-f): three of the set's demoted figures as the owner wrote them.
- Leaked test schemas "stays visible until it has read 0 for 7 days, then an alert only".
- Dollars per landing is "shown under sustainability as a plain reading, no range".
- Free disk is a diagnostic with no range. Its alert is disk_low's (objective 204). It stays in the answer and in the samples, because its fall is how a sweep's effect is read (the lead's ruling, and lead-mac's rule of 2026-11-16; this departs from the set's "alert only" wording on purpose).
All of it is monitoring only: no gate, integrator or deploy reads it.

Base: live main 6f8ceb8c.

Read first:
- sync/core-metric-set-2026-11-14.md, "Demoted";
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (ALERT_FIGURES, DIAGNOSTICS, ALERTING_DIAGNOSTICS, Set, adopted, answer, core_lines_timed, sample_values);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/trends.rs (trend_since);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts/guardrails.rs (figures: the lines, alert_figures and the diagnostics that carry a line);
- web/src/coreLines.ts (coreLinesView, mark, pendingWords).

What changes (spawn-cli serve/core_lines, and web; no store change):
(1) Free disk (storage.free_bytes) moves from `alert_figures` to `diagnostics`, first in the list. It has no range and no line, so it raises nothing.
   - A ranges file entry for it (bound or target) is not applied. It is listed in `ignored_ranges` with the reason "an alert of its own (disk_low, objective 204)".
   - It is still read and sampled hourly, and its trend and days left's readings (objective 141) are unchanged.
   - An open guardrail_out_of_range alert for it clears as "gone", as for any figure that leaves the lists.
(2) Dollars per landing (performance.usd_per_landing) moves from `diagnostics` to the sustainability line's `readings` (new; every line has the list, empty for storage and performance).
   - A reading has no range and is never judged. Its figure says the `range_note` "no range until use with no price is under 10%" (181's field: the card says the note where the range would be).
   - A ranges file entry for it (bound or target) is not applied. It is listed in `ignored_ranges` with the reason "shown with no range until use with no price is under 10% (the owner's core metric set)".
   - It raises nothing: the alert step reads no reading.
   - When use with no price (U3) is under 10%, the owner rules its range. No automatic range (the lead's ruling).
(3) Leaked test schemas (storage.leaked_test_schemas) is a diagnostic raising under storage, as now, until it has read 0 for 7 days. Then it is the last of `alert_figures` (line storage), alert only, and no diagnostic.
   - It has read 0 for 7 days when its value now is 0 and every host.core_lines sample since now − 7 × 24 h carries it as 0.
   - A missing sample is not a zero. The oldest of those samples must lie within 2 h of the week's start, no two of them more than 2 h apart, and the newest within 2 h of now. A sample in the week that does not carry it as a number is not a zero either.
   - A non-zero value now, or any non-zero sample in the week, makes it a diagnostic again.
   - The rule is quiet.rs's zero_for_a_week (new). The answer, the guardrail step's reading and the hourly sample all apply it (core_lines_timed and sample_values). In the sample it is carried either way.
(4) The samples those paths read start a week back (now − 7 × 24 h, `samples_since`), not at trend_since (UTC midnight 6 days back), so the rule sees the whole week. The trends and the disk's readings filter their own windows as before, so their values are unchanged.
(5) The page:
   - coreLinesView gains each row's `readings` (marks: the note where the range would be);
   - the Home card shows them under the row's guardrails;
   - pendingWords says a range ignored on purpose by its figure's name and its reason, not "range not read";
   - the Fleet page's storage cell lists the diagnostics as it does now, free disk first.

What stays as it is:
- every figure's reading, key and unit;
- the ranges file's form;
- the guardrail step (alerts/guardrails.rs is not changed: it reads the lines, `alert_figures` and the diagnostics carrying a line, so a reading and free disk raise nothing, and leaked test schemas raises in either list);
- the lines' figures;
- the other alert figures and diagnostics;
- ALERTING_DIAGNOSTICS (leaked test schemas, under storage);
- the hysteresis and evidence.

Polled read (the lead times it on live before the push): the host.core_lines samples read (HOST_CORE_LINES, through spawn_events_host_core_lines on recorded_at_ms) runs on every /api/core-lines answer, every guardrail reading and every hourly sample. Its window grows from UTC midnight − 6 d (6 to 7 days) to exactly 7 days: at most about 24 more hourly samples. The SELECT, as the code runs it, with the 7-day window:
  psql "$SPAWN_DATABASE_URL" -c "explain (analyze, buffers) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('at_ms', s.recorded_at_ms, 'values', s.vals) order by s.recorded_at_ms, s.id), '[]'::jsonb) from (select e.recorded_at_ms, e.id, e.kind -> 'detail' -> 'record' -> 'values' as vals from spawn_events e where e.session_id = 'session_control' and e.event_name = 'control.recorded' and e.kind -> 'detail' -> 'record' ->> 'type' = 'host.core_lines' and e.recorded_at_ms >= (extract(epoch from clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint - 7 * 86400000) s"
For the base's window, replace the bound with (floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp()) * 1000 / 86400000) * 86400000)::bigint - 6 * 86400000. The lead also times it at a 24 h window, for scale.

Tests:
- serve/core_lines/quiet.rs: leaked_schemas_read_zero_for_a_week_only_with_samples_across_it (new). A full week of hourly zeros; older non-zero samples outside the week; a value now of 1 or null; one sample in the week at 3, null or missing the figure; a gap at the week's start, inside it, and before now; no samples; samples two hours apart.
- serve/core_lines.rs:
  - free_disk_is_a_diagnostic_and_dollars_per_landing_a_reading_with_no_range (new): the ranges and targets ignored with their reasons, another diagnostic keeping its range, the readings of each line, the note;
  - leaked_schemas_quiet_for_a_week_is_an_alert_figure_only (new);
  - the_demoted_figures_are_alert_figures_with_their_lines_or_diagnostics (adapted: the lists' new contents).
- serve/core_lines/trends.rs's every-list test: free disk's trend is now found in the diagnostics.
- web/test/coreLines.test.ts: "a line's plain reading says its note, never a range; free disk is a diagnostic (objective 182)" (new).
- No test is renamed or dropped.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/quiet.rs (new), and the call sites of adopted in core_lines/observability.rs, performance.rs, storage.rs and trends.rs (tests); web/src/coreLines.ts, web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx, web/test/coreLines.test.ts. The owner's part (182-owner.diff): rsi/scenarios/182.sh (new), and the kept scenarios that read the moved figures:
- 089.sh and 092.sh take leaked test schemas, not free disk, as their guardrail figure: {"max": -1}, out from the first reading whatever it counts, then {"max": 1e18}. Its one test server is a second scratch database, named by a URL file (mode 0600).
- 090.sh finds free disk's trend among the diagnostics.
- 176.sh: the alert figures without free disk; the diagnostics with free disk first and without dollars per landing; free disk's ignored range; no free-disk alert in (6).
- 086.sh: dollars per landing as a reading with no range.
- rsi/backlog/182.json.
Size: fleet about +330 −40 (code about +110: core_lines.rs 75, quiet.rs 55, web 25; tests about +220). Owner: 182.sh 296 lines, kept scenarios about +90 −50.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/182.sh, black box through GET /api/core-lines.
- The scenario's database, and a second one of its own as the serve's test server, so leaked test schemas reads 0.
- A ranges file giving free disk {"min": 1e18}, dollars per landing {"max": 1, "target": 0.5} and leaked test schemas {"max": 0}.
Checks:
- (1) Free disk is among the diagnostics: valued, range null, state no_range, no line. It is no alert figure. Its entry is ignored, with its reason.
- (2) The lines' readings are storage [], performance [], sustainability [performance.usd_per_landing]. The reading has range null, no target, and its range_note. It is neither a diagnostic nor an alert figure. Its entry is ignored, with its reason.
- (3) Leaked test schemas (host.core_lines samples seeded into the scenario's database):
  - (a) with no sample: a diagnostic of line storage, 0;
  - (b) with hourly samples at 0 from 7 days 2 hours ago to now: the last alert figure, line storage, and no diagnostic. A real `spawn loop` started then writes its start-up sample with storage.leaked_test_schemas the number 0 (an alert figure stays sampled, so the week does not end an hour later; rev-e's F1);
  - (c) one sample three days ago at 2: a diagnostic;
  - (d) three hours of samples missing four days ago: a diagnostic;
  - (e) the samples all 0, but none in the last three hours (the loop stopped): a diagnostic, since the week must reach now;
  - (g) the samples all 0, but the first only 7 days less 3 hours ago (the week begins late): a diagnostic;
  - (h) hourly samples over the week that do not carry the figure, while it reads 0 now: a diagnostic, since a sample without it is not a zero (rev-e's F2);
  - (f) the samples all 0 again, and a leftover schema planted in the test database (no owner, made two days ago by its comment): it reads 1, a diagnostic.
On live main (73cbdd8e, and the base 6f8ceb8c) 182.sh exits 1: free disk is an alert figure, dollars per landing a diagnostic, and leaked test schemas never leaves the diagnostics. The kept scenarios (086, 089, 090, 092, 176) pass on the throwaway as adapted.

Verified by: the gate runs 182.sh and the adapted scenarios. Live, the Home card shows dollars per landing under Sustainability with its note. The Fleet page's storage cell lists free disk first. Leaked test schemas leaves the storage cell for good only after a week of hourly samples at 0.
